exclusion_accounting.policy: A reviewed staging virtual address becomes a function record only if its body was reconstructed, mechanically re-verified against the live disassembly and given a passing four-configuration focused test. Every other address the tranche touched is recorded as a dependency-only exclusion in the helper_and_data_vas_not_promoted field of each metadata document, and the two sets partition the 248 staging addresses with no overlap and no remainder.
exclusion_accounting.advanced_palette: the full pkg-advanced-palette-wave11 package contributed no promoted address. Its staging package was neither edited nor copied and no canonical directory, metadata directory or record exists for it.

reconciliation.summary: The tranche brief enumerated twenty-one excluded addresses. All twenty-one are now recorded individually in excluded_addresses: ten body-level exclusions carried over from the review, the deferred editor body 0x004c73f0, and the ten pkg-advanced-palette-wave11 bodies held as a package. The 218 dependency-only addresses remain accounted for in each metadata document's helper_and_data_vas_not_promoted field; the two sets partition the 248 staging addresses with no overlap and no remainder.
reconciliation.authority: Reconciled by the integrating agent against the review brief; the exclusion decisions themselves are the reviews' findings, not new judgements.

deferred_full_package_claims.policy: Only the seven safe-split packages were copied. Each full or defective staging package remains staging-only, and the overlap between a full package and its safe split is left for adjudication rather than resolved by this batch.
deferred_full_package_claims.adjudication_required: Whether any pkg-advanced-palette-wave11 body is sound enough to promote after its own repair pass. Its ten-VA full package stays staging-only and no address in it was promoted.

untouched_packages.policy: This staging package was neither edited nor copied. No canonical directory, no metadata directory and no manifest record exists for it, and none of its addresses was promoted.

reviews.reviewers: per-package semantic reviewer plus integrator cross-check
reviews.scope: observed mechanics, receiver field offsets, gate bit widths, port classification and the semantic label for each of the thirty bodies

reviews.reviewers: per-package ABI and type reviewer plus integrator cross-check
reviews.scope: argument count, width and lane, register and stack argument placement, stack cleanup width, RET form, return register and the opaque structure field offsets

reviews.reviewers: per-package runtime and lifecycle reviewer plus integrator cross-check
reviews.scope: receiver class identity, ownership and release ordering, vtable reachability, port lifetime and every runtime gate that remains open

The three passes above each returned findings, so a repair pass corrected them and a fourth independent pass re-read the repaired evidence against the live disassembly. Every correction is recorded per address in the decompilation_defects_corrected field of its metadata document rather than being silently absorbed.

provenance.ghidra_evidence: The thirty target bodies, their byte extents, their sha256 digests and their instruction counts were read from the live Ghidra database and re-derived from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400, version 3.1.0.22). The nineteen mechanically-derived instruction counts were produced by a linear objdump of each byte extent; the remaining eleven come from the reviewed staging handoff for that address and are labelled as such in observed_body.instruction_count_source. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
